summary: Retain required mining fluids in acquisition and science progression.
details: Fluid-consuming mined outputs require acquisition of the exact fluid instead of acting as unconditional starting inputs. Missing fluids, differently typed items and unseeded cycles cannot acquire a lab or supply a recipe route.

Independent fluid sources and production alternatives remain usable. A selected lab or recipe route retains the mining fluid's research unlocks; a researched witness cannot become an initial acquisition answer through shared memo reuse.

Controlled canonical lab, researchability and source-epoch checks cover the correction and adapter boundary. Native mining, final catalogue, progression, existing saves and migration implications remain unqualified; no new productivity permission or support claim is granted.
